name: San Francisco Golf Club
location: San Francisco (Lakeshore, by Lake Merced), California
architects: A. W. Tillinghast (designed c. 1915, opened 1918; remodels c. 1920-37); William P. Bell bunkers 1930; Tom Doak and Jim Urbina restoration 2001-06

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM (3DEPElevation exportImage), x 545200-546900 / y 4173000-4174500 EPSG:32610, NAVD88 metres, clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py raster; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-sfgc)

laz.source: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud, project CA_SanFrancisco_B23 (CA_SanFrancisco_1_B23), 16 tiles, class 1 (the tiles carry classes 1, 2 and 7: no vegetation classes, so trees come from class 1 with roofs dropped by roof_last_share, as at the Olympic Club); NAD83(2011) / San Francisco CS13 (EPSG:7131), NAVD88 m; clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py laz (CRS kept); fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-sfgc; tiles that timed out on retry runs)
laz.label: USGS 3DEP lidar (San Francisco)

tee_sets.name: White
tee_sets.why_not_playable: 11th and 12th fail (+9.9 %, +11.3 %): OSM maps one box on each, the Blue one (course chat, 2026-11-13; open item)

scorecard_source: Third-party (private club; no official card online, no yardage markers): Stymie's per-hole card (par, men's stroke index, Blue/White/White-Red/Legacy/Green), with GolfPass's women's stroke index, read 2026-10-24 by the scouting chat (docs/scouting/sfgc/scorecard_sources.md, branch scouting/new-courses); GolfPass differs on five cells. Ratings from Stymie (Blue 73.6/133). Unverified against a printed card.
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-11-13: the longest tee set (Blue) and it is the default; all water red; OB = the OSM course boundary (the Olympic Club and its features dropped), roads inside it are cart paths, the driving range is OB; open-coast wind 3-14 mph; trees from 3DEP lidar, trees in fairways or in the way of a centre-line drive removed and listed. Theme sfgc (new; the course chat's design).

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (1130 x 861 m, way/16753994) + at least 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (203 m west/east, 210 m south/north)
